summary:
Results-oriented Digital Transformation Expert with over 11+ years of experience in the
lending and financial services domain, driving large-scale digital initiatives across retail,
SME, and corporate lending products. Demonstrated success in end-to-end project
management, business rule engine implementation, and API-led integration, delivering
measurable outcomes such as improved TAT, enhanced underwriting automation, and
scalable lending platforms. Skilled at bridging business strategy and technology innovation
to accelerate growth and operational efficiency.
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
• Proven leadership in managing digital transformation programs across multiple lending
products — including home loans, home equity, two-wheeler, car, SME, farm, personal,
credit card, consumer, microfinance and business loans.
• Directed end-to-end implementation of rule engines (FICO Blaze, PowerCurve, SDS) and
machine learning models for automated credit decisions and risk management.
• Designed and executed API-led integrations with fintech and third-party services (Perfios,
Digio, LegalDesk, EarlySalary, MoneyTap, Kreditbee, credit bureaus), reducing TAT and
improving onboarding experience.
• Led decision analytics, BRMS, and data engineering projects to enable faster, data-driven
loan underwriting.
• Developed and managed multi-bureau integration systems improving accuracy of
customer profiling and credit risk assessment.
• Managed 8 to 10 member team with various skill set android , salesforce, java developer
and tester as per need in various project cycles
• Translated business requirements into scalable digital solutions enhancing customer
experience and business growth.
• Recognized multiple times for outstanding project delivery, innovation, and performance
excellence.
